name: Email
description: An email message as received from a mailbox such as Gmail: envelope, body, headers and the stored attachments, with the mailbox it came from and our own triage on top.

global.schema:
type EmailState {
  account: MailAccount!
  externalId: String
  messageId: String
  threadId: String
  inReplyTo: String
  references: [String!]!
  subject: String
  from: [Mailbox!]!
  to: [Mailbox!]!
  cc: [Mailbox!]!
  bcc: [Mailbox!]!
  replyTo: [Mailbox!]!
  sentAt: DateTime
  receivedAt: DateTime
  text: String
  html: String
  snippet: String
  headers: [EmailHeader!]!
  labels: [String!]!
  attachments: [EmailAttachment!]!
  status: EmailStatus!
  read: Boolean!
  flagged: Boolean!
  notes: String
  source: String
  capturedAt: DateTime
}

type MailAccount {
  address: String
  name: String
  provider: String
}

type Mailbox {
  address: String!
  name: String
}

type EmailHeader {
  key: String!
  value: String!
}

type EmailAttachment {
  id: OID!
  ref: AttachmentRef!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  contentId: String
  inline: Boolean!
}

enum EmailStatus {
  INBOX
  ARCHIVED
}
global.initialValue: {"account": {"address": null, "name": null, "provider": null}, "externalId": null, "messageId": null, "threadId": null, "inReplyTo": null, "references": [], "subject": null, "from": [], "to": [], "cc": [], "bcc": [], "replyTo": [], "sentAt": null, "receivedAt": null, "text": null, "html": null, "snippet": null, "headers": [], "labels": [], "attachments": [], "status": "INBOX", "read": false, "flagged": false, "notes": null, "source": null, "capturedAt": null}

modules.name: message
modules.description: The mailbox, the captured message and our note

operations.name: SET_ACCOUNT
operations.description: The mailbox this message belongs to

operations.name: CAPTURE_MESSAGE
operations.description: File the message as received: identity, envelope, body and headers in one step; a re-capture replaces them
operations.schema:
input CaptureMessageInput {
  externalId: String!
  messageId: String
  threadId: String
  inReplyTo: String
  references: [String!]
  subject: String
  from: [CapturedMailboxInput!]!
  to: [CapturedMailboxInput!]
  cc: [CapturedMailboxInput!]
  bcc: [CapturedMailboxInput!]
  replyTo: [CapturedMailboxInput!]
  sentAt: DateTime
  receivedAt: DateTime
  text: String
  html: String
  headers: [CapturedHeaderInput!]
  labels: [String!]
  source: String
  capturedAt: DateTime!
}

input CapturedMailboxInput {
  address: String!
  name: String
}

input CapturedHeaderInput {
  key: String!
  value: String!
}

errors.name: InvalidExternalIdError
errors.description: The external id must be namespaced by its system, e.g. gmail:18f3a

errors.name: ExternalIdMismatchError
errors.description: The document already holds a different message

operations.name: SET_NOTES
operations.description: A note of our own beside the message

operations.name: ADD_ATTACHMENT
operations.description: Record a stored file as part of the message
operations.schema:
input AddAttachmentInput {
  id: OID!
  ref: AttachmentRef!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  contentId: String
  inline: Boolean
}

errors.name: DuplicateAttachmentError
errors.description: The attachment is already on the message

operations.name: REMOVE_ATTACHMENT
ARCHIVE
operations.reducer:
if (state.status === "ARCHIVED") throw new AlreadyArchivedError("The message is archived already");
state.status = "ARCHIVED";

operations.name: UNARCHIVE
operations.reducer:
if (state.status !== "ARCHIVED") throw new NotArchivedError("The message is not archived");
state.status = "INBOX";

operations.name: ADD_LABELS
REMOVE_LABELS

errors.name: LabelNotFoundError
errors.description: The message does not carry that label
